events.verdict: Embiid (PHI) firms up in a screening position in Agbaji's (TOR) path and does not deliver contact.
Quickley (TOR) brings his off-arm toward Oubre Jr. (PHI) and releases away as he steps back.
Mogbo (TOR) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Quickley (TOR) briefly has an arm around Oubre Jr.'s (PHI) leg as he drives toward the basket.
George (PHI) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball to deflect it away from Barnes (TOR).
Mogbo's (TOR) shot attempt does not make contact with the rim and the shot clock expires before Philadelphia possesses the ball.
Embiid (PHI) establishes himself in a screening position in Agbaji's (TOR) path and the two players briefly engage and disengage.
Embiid (PHI) loses control of the ball on his own accord and Dick (TOR) makes clean contact with it to steal it away.
Maxey (PHI) commits a take foul on Dick (TOR).
Agbaji (TOR) grazes Maxey's (PHI) arm as he moves along with him off of the ball and the contact is marginal.

After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that Grimes (PHI) does not release the shot attempt before the expiration of the game clock and the on-court ruling is overturned to no basket.
